definition: II. [ חוּשׁ ] verb feel, enjoy (with the senses) ( Now compares Arabic feel, perceive by senses; Late Hebrew חוּשׁ feel pain ; Aramaic , חוּשׁ , feel pain ; Ethiopic : perception ) — only Qal Imperfect 3 masculine singular מִּי יאֹכַל וּמִי יָחוּשׁ Eccl 2:25 who can eat and who can feel (i.e. enjoy pleasure )?
